newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian ambassador among Peru hostages, unhurt.
newsitem.headline: Austrian ambassador among Peru hostages, unhurt.

text.p: Austria's ambassador to Peru was among some 200 hostages held by armed guerrillas in the Japanese ambassador's residence in Lima on Wednesday, the Austrian foreign ministry said.
A spokeswoman said Ambassador Arthur Schuschnigg was unhurt and was being held with a handful of other hostages in one of the residence's bathrooms.
"He's sitting in the bathtub with the Germans," she said. "We've set up a crisis centre in the foreign ministry."
Austria's ambassador to Bogota had been ordered to come to Lima and take over the running of the embassy, she added.
Austrian state television reported that Schuschnigg's wife had been released earlier in the day.
Cuban-inspired Tupac Amaru Revolutionary Movement guerrillas attacked the residence late on Tuesday, spraying gunfire into the building before taking it over, eyewitnesses said.
